        share = "n/a" if d["excluded_share"] is None else \
----

    render_decisions(L, P, absent, rules)
    L(efp_line)
    L("")

#!/usr/bin/env bats

setup() {

teardown() {

@test "VS-1 the committed suite (tasks/ and smoke/) validates with --allow-partial; without it, every type short of four tasks is one counts line" {

  n="$(find "$CR/tasks" "$CR/smoke" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name task.yaml 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

# plan_phases <toggles-json> → JSON array of {name,label}
plan_phases() {
  jq -c -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --argjson tg "$1" --arg kind "$KIND" '
    ( if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end ) as $dflt
    | ( $arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt ) as $p0
    | ( if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end ) as $p1
    | ( if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end ) as $p2
    | ( if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null
          then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end ) as $p3
    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += [{name: "FIX", label: ("FIX" + (.fix | tostring))}]
        else .out += [{name: $n, label: $n}] end)
    | .out'
}

phase_skill() {  # the Loa skill a phase invokes (for effort_requested)
  case "$1" in
    PLAN) echo planning-sprints ;; IMPLEMENT|FIX) echo implementing-tasks ;;
    REVIEW) echo reviewing-code ;; AUDIT) echo auditing-security ;; *) echo "" ;;
  esac
}
builtin_model() { case "$1" in REVIEW|AUDIT) echo global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1 ;; *) echo global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 ;; esac; }
builtin_turns() { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 30 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 60 ;; REVIEW|FIX|AUDIT) echo 40 ;; BARE) echo 170 ;; *) echo 40 ;; esac; }
builtin_tmin()  { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 15 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 25 ;; REVIEW|AUDIT) echo 20 ;; FIX) echo 15 ;; BARE) echo 70 ;; *) echo 20 ;; esac; }

BARE_FABLE_MODEL="global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1"
BARE_MODEL_TOGGLE="$(jq -r '.bare_model // empty' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"   # re-read from the library's toggles below
phase_model() {  # bare_model: fable (cycle-131 D-5.1) decides BARE over every other source
  if [[ "$1" == BARE && "$BARE_MODEL_TOGGLE" == fable ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$BARE_FABLE_MODEL"; return 0; fi

}
phase_cap() {  # phase_cap <name> max_turns|timeout_min — task bounds > suite phase_defaults > built-in;
               # BARE without a declaration = PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 × FIX
  local n="$1" key="$2" v

# plan_phases <toggles-json> → JSON array of {name,label}
plan_phases() {
  jq -c -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --argjson tg "$1" --arg kind "$KIND" '
    ( if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end ) as $dflt
    | ( $arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt ) as $p0
    | ( if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end ) as $p1
    | ( if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end ) as $p2
    | ( if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null
          then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end ) as $p3
    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += [{name: "FIX", label: ("FIX" + (.fix | tostring))}]

    | .out'

source_commit: "ba11b860"   # the pin: the Sprint 259 completion tree (rc.5 + the #1267 mount fix + the harness; .claude/ identical to the Sprint 258 completion tree, DEC-0529; the per-batch .claude/ delta vs 4d69c3c4 is in MANIFEST.json, DEC-0392)
agy_opt_in: false
tasks:
  root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/tasks
  manifest: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/MANIFEST.sha256
  smoke_root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/smoke
suite_version: 2   # suite v2 (DEC-0559, DEC-0566): twelve harder build tasks with v2 ids; the four review-catch tasks unchanged in content
trials: {build: 3, review-catch: 3}      # D-A4: review-catch trials 3, not 5, under the gate pipeline
cut_ladder: ["A5, A6, A7 not run", "A2 and A3 build trials 3 -> 2", "A3 review-catch trials 3 -> 2"]   # DEC-0397; A0, A1, A4 keep 3
# Per-run caps (DEC-0559, DEC-0567): from Sprint 261 the cap is per task kind,
# run_usd_by_type {build: 15, review-catch: 20}; run-ablation.sh passes the kind's cap to
# pipeline-run.sh --max-run-usd, charges a cap failure or a costless failed trial that
# kind's cap, and reserves in-flight trials at the largest cap among the plan's kinds.
# run_usd stays the single-cap fallback (suite v1 batches, a kind without an entry) and
# --run-cap overrides both kinds. reserve_usd is kept for spend.sh; DEC-0559 released the
# reserve (a batch's --max-usd = 1,500 - spend so far - concurrency x the largest cap).
caps: {cycle_usd: 1500, run_usd: 12, reserve_usd: 250, run_usd_by_type: {build: 15, review-catch: 20}}
priority: [a0_bare, a1_full, a2_no_sprint_plan, a3_one_voice, a4_no_gates, a7_effort_medium, a5_no_flatline, a6_one_window]
cost_hint: {build: 7, review-catch: 8}   # USD per run before any actual exists (run-arms/run-ablation est_next fallback)

# Session defaults per phase (SDD D-4.3). A6's continued session carries the
# caps of the phase it is in; A0's BARE caps are PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX.
phase_defaults:
  models:
    PLAN: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    IMPLEMENT: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    FIX: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    BARE: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    REVIEW: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
    AUDIT: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
  # REVIEW/AUDIT 60 turns / 30 min: the Sprint 258 smoke saw a review-catch AUDIT hit 40 turns after writing its
  # verdict (DEC-0490); BARE stays the implementer-side sum (PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX)
  max_turns: {PLAN: 30, IMPLEMENT: 60, REVIEW: 60, FIX: 40, AUDIT: 60, BARE: 170}
  timeout_min: {PLAN: 15, IMPLEMENT: 25, REVIEW: 30, FIX: 15, AUDIT: 30, BARE: 70}
  tools: "Bash,Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch"   # identical for every arm, A0 included
phase_sets:   # D-4.1: A1's phases per task type; FIX runs only after a CHANGES_REQUIRED gate
  review-catch: [REVIEW, AUDIT]
  build: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX]

arms:
  - {id: a0_bare, label: A0, task_types: [all], toggles: {loa_mount: false}, phases: [BARE], effort: high,
     took_effect: [no_dot_claude, no_system_prompt, no_audit_rows, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a1_full, label: A1, task_types: [all], toggles: {}, took_effect: [all_phases_present, oracle_closed, integrity_clean]}   # oracle_closed: cycle-131 FR-1 (DEC-0615); review-catch runs only, a build run passes it vacuously
  - {id: a2_no_sprint_plan, label: A2, task_types: [build], toggles: {sprint_plan: false},
     phases: [IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX],
     took_effect: [no_plan_phase, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a3_one_voice, label: A3, task_types: [all], toggles: {companion_voice: false}, took_effect: [one_voice_planned, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a4_no_gates, label: A4, task_types: [build], toggles: {gates: false},
     phases: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT],
     took_effect: [no_gate_phases, enforce_env_false, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}   # build only: on a review-catch task the gates are the task (DEC-0400)
  - {id: a5_no_flatline, label: A5, task_types: [build], toggles: {flatline: false},
     took_effect: [no_flatline_rows, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a6_one_window, label: A6, task_types: [build], toggles: {context_resets: false},
     took_effect: [implementer_single_session, gates_separate_sessions, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a7_effort_medium, label: A7, task_types: [all], toggles: {effort: medium},
     took_effect: [effort_flag_medium, skill_effort_stripped, integrity_clean]}
  # cycle-131 FR-5 (DEC-0619, SDD §3.2 "Entity: suite arm"): review-catch only. a0_bare_fable is A0 on the
  # review model; a1_review_only drops the AUDIT gate; a1_no_dissent turns the review gate's dissent off;
  # a1_full_openmount is the cycle-130 open mount, eval_only (pipeline-run.sh refuses it outside a
  # run-ablation.sh batch or smoke: LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=1) and never a decision arm
  - {id: a0_bare_fable, label: A0F, task_types: [review-catch], toggles: {loa_mount: false, bare_model: fable}, phases: [BARE], effort: high,
     took_effect: [no_dot_claude, no_system_prompt, no_audit_rows, bare_model_fable, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a1_review_only, label: A1R, task_types: [review-catch], toggles: {}, phases: [REVIEW],
     took_effect: [review_only_phases, oracle_closed, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a1_no_dissent, label: A1N, task_types: [review-catch], toggles: {dissent: false},
     took_effect: [all_phases_present, no_review_dissent_envelope, oracle_closed, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a1_full_openmount, label: A1O, task_types: [review-catch], toggles: {oracle_open: true}, eval_only: true,
     took_effect: [all_phases_present, oracle_open_recorded, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a8_no_ceremonies, label: A8, absent: true,
     evidence: "no /meeting command, skill or sosyete config key at 4d69c3c4 (grep -rli sosyete .claude/ docs/; ls .claude/commands .claude/skills)"}

rules:   # D-A5: pre-registered, mirrored in NOTES
  threshold_points: 0.03
  cost_lower_pct: 15
  bootstrap: {resamples: 10000, level: 0.90, paired: true, units: {hidden_test_pass_rate: tasks, defect_catch_rate: defects}, also_report: {defect_catch_rate: tasks}}   # DEC-0399
  primaries_by_arm: {build_only: [hidden_test_pass_rate], all_types: [hidden_test_pass_rate, defect_catch_rate]}   # DEC-0400
  cap_failure: counts_as_failed            # 0 on each applicable primary (DEC-0393)
  exclusion: {statuses: [degraded, contaminated, interrupted], mode: pairwise, inconclusive_above_share: 0.25}
  sensitivity_figure: cap_failures_excluded  # printed, never decides
  multiple_comparisons: none                 # expected false positives at 0.90 over 6 components printed
  drift_guard: {cli_version: fixed_per_batch, model_ids: fixed_per_batch}   # DEC-0407
  order: trial_major_seeded_shuffle_within_block
  took_effect_per_trial: true                # a miss → infrastructure_error, arm paused until --clear-arm (DEC-0418)

=== freeze/gate pre-flight in run-ablation.sh
# --- pre-flight ----------------------------------------------------------------------
GATE_JSON=null
if [[ "$SMOKE" != true ]]; then
  [[ -f "$SUITE_ROOT/MANIFEST.sha256" ]] || refuse "hard gate (DEC-0435): $SUITE_ROOT/MANIFEST.sha256 is missing (freeze the suite first)"
  [[ -f "$SELF_CHECK_LOG" ]] || refuse "hard gate (DEC-0435): the self-check log $SELF_CHECK_LOG is missing"
  n_all=${#ALL_TASKS[@]} n_rc=0
  for t in "${ALL_TASKS[@]}"; do [[ "$(yq -r '.type' "$TDIR/$t/task.yaml")" == review-catch ]] && n_rc=$((n_rc + 1)); done
  want_pass=$(( 2 * n_all + n_rc ))
  got_pass="$(grep -cE ': PASS( |$)' "$SELF_CHECK_LOG" || true)"
  got_fail="$(grep -cE ': FAIL( |$)' "$SELF_CHECK_LOG" || true)"
  [[ "$got_fail" -eq 0 ]] || refuse "hard gate (DEC-0435): the self-check log has $got_fail FAIL line(s)"
  [[ "$got_pass" -ge "$want_pass" ]] || refuse "hard gate (DEC-0435): the self-check log has $got_pass PASS lines, want $want_pass (2 x $n_all tasks + $n_rc review-catch)"
  missing_review=""
  for t in "${ALL_TASKS[@]}"; do [[ -f "$TDIR/$t/REVIEW.md" ]] || missing_review="$missing_review $t"; done
  [[ -z "$missing_review" ]] || refuse "hard gate (DEC-0435): no REVIEW.md in tasks/{${missing_review# }}"
  GATE_JSON="$(python3 -I - "$SUITE_ROOT" "$SELF_CHECK_LOG" "$got_pass" "${ALL_TASKS[@]}" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, os, sys
root, log, npass, tasks = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], int(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4:]
h = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
print(json.dumps({"manifest": os.path.join(root, "MANIFEST.sha256"), "manifest_sha256": h(os.path.join(root, "MANIFEST.sha256")),
                  "self_check_log": log, "self_check_log_sha256": h(log), "self_check_pass_lines": npass,
                  "review_md": {t: h(os.path.join(root, "tasks", t, "REVIEW.md")) for t in tasks}}, sort_keys=True))
PY
)"
fi
FREEZE_ARGS=(--check --root "$SUITE_ROOT" --suite-file "$SUITE_FILE")
if [[ "$SMOKE" == true ]] || grep -q '  smoke/' "$SUITE_ROOT/MANIFEST.sha256" 2>/dev/null; then FREEZE_ARGS+=(--smoke); fi
[[ "$ALLOW_PARTIAL" == true ]] && FREEZE_ARGS+=(--allow-partial)
frc=0; fout="$("$FREEZE_BIN" "${FREEZE_ARGS[@]}" 2>&1)" || frc=$?
[[ $frc -eq 0 ]] || refuse "freeze.sh ${FREEZE_ARGS[*]} failed (exit $frc): $(printf '%s' "$fout" | tail -5 | tr '\n' ' ')"
SUITE_MANIFEST_SHA="$(sha_file "$SUITE_ROOT/MANIFEST.sha256")"
crc=0; cout="$("$CORPUS_BIN" --check 2>&1)" || crc=$?
[[ $crc -eq 0 ]] || refuse "seed-corpus-from-record.sh --check failed (exit $crc): $(printf '%s' "$cout" | tail -3 | tr '\n' ' ')"
CORPUS_SHA="$(sha_file "$REPO_ROOT/evals/fixtures/review-prs/SHA256SUMS" 2>/dev/null || echo "")"

IMAGE_DIGEST=""
if [[ "$EXECUTOR" == container ]]; then
  command -v "$DOCKER_BIN" >/dev/null 2>&1 || [[ -x "$DOCKER_BIN" ]] || refuse "docker CLI not found: $DOCKER_BIN"

head/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:55 — `priority` was not extended with the four new arms. run-ablation.sh derives the default `--arms` set from `.priority` minus absent arms (run-ablation.sh:570-573), so a batch or smoke launched without an explicit `--arms` never schedules a0_bare_fable, a1_review_only, a1_no_dissent or a1_full_openmount; the arms this sprint adds are unreachable by default, and `cut_ladder` (line 46) likewise says nothing about them.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:656 — `primaries()` maps any arm whose task_types contains review-catch to `all_types` = [hidden_test_pass_rate, defect_catch_rate]. For the new review-catch-only components (a1_review_only, a1_no_dissent, a0_bare_fable) the pass-rate comparison can never have a pair, so `usable()` is false, `nopair` is always true and `decide()` can only return investigate, keep or "inconclusive: no valid pair (hidden_test_pass_rate)"; remove/simplify are structurally unreachable for every arm this PR adds as a component. A review-catch-only arm needs a catch-only primary set (and rules.primaries_by_arm a matching key).
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:1913 — a0_bare_fable is counted as a component: it gets a remove/keep/simplify decision row against a1_full and inflates k in the expected-false-positives line. It is a bare baseline (loa_mount: false, "A0 on the review model" per the suite), not a removable component; the test comment at head/evals/tests/ablation-report.bats:189 even calls all three "control arms" while asserting they are components. Exclude bare arms (or mark the arm non-decision) rather than deciding on a baseline.
head/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:100 — a1_review_only's took_effect names `review_only_phases`, and a1_no_dissent (line 102) names `no_review_dissent_envelope`; neither id appears anywhere in the base tree and this PR does not touch took-effect.sh to add a `rule_<id>()` for them (the Sprint 263 fixture arms used `all_phases_present` instead). Under this PR's own validate-suite.sh check 8 the committed suite then fails with "took_effect names unknown rule id", VS-14/VS-16 fail, and a real trial on those arms would be infrastructure_error per DEC-0418. If the rules do exist in took-effect.sh they must be shown in this change; as submitted it is unverifiable and inconsistent with the rest of the tree.
head/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:117 — the `multiple_comparisons` comment still says "over 6 components"; the report (and AR-12) now print 9. The rules block is quoted verbatim into the report's Method section, so the stale text ships into every report.
head/evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh:341 — the dry-run re-implements apply_arm_toggles' toggle→config-edit mapping inline (and validate-suite.sh:137-139 hard-codes the toggle vocabulary a second time) instead of deriving it from lib/sandbox-mount.sh. Three copies of the same table with no test tying them together will drift the first time a toggle is added; at minimum the dry-run should call the library or the vocabulary should be exported from it.
head/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:41 — the PR title promises "the cycle-131 suite root (bounds 50/40) with its image self-check", but no suite-root, bounds or self-check file is in the change (the 11 files are harness, suite yaml and tests only; the new RAB-c131-5 test still copies the existing grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0 root). Either the description over-claims or part of the sprint is missing from the PR.
Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED
EOF
cat review.md | wc -l

content.text:
Review written to `review.md`. Verdict: **CHANGES_REQUIRED**.

The eval_only refusal, batch-context export, validate-suite arm schema and the new tests are internally consistent and the header line ranges, ordering of the refusal before run-dir creation, and the dry-run plan all check out. The defects are around how the four new arms integrate with the runner and the report:

- **New arms never run by default.** The suite's `priority` list was not extended, and run-ablation.sh derives its default `--arms` from it. Without an explicit `--arms`, no batch or smoke schedules any of the four arms.
- **Report decisions for the new components are structurally inconclusive.** A review-catch-only arm gets both primaries, and the pass-rate comparison can never pair, so `decide()` can never return remove or simplify for a1_review_only or a1_no_dissent.
- **a0_bare_fable is treated as a component.** It is a bare baseline but gets a remove/keep decision row against a1_full and inflates the expected-false-positives count.
- **Two took_effect rule ids look undefined.** `review_only_phases` and `no_review_dissent_envelope` appear nowhere in the base tree and took-effect.sh is not in the change. The PR's own validator check 8 would then fail the committed suite. I could not see took-effect.sh, so this is flagged as unverifiable rather than certain.
- **Minor:** stale "over 6 components" comment in the rules block that is quoted verbatim into reports, the toggle table now duplicated in three places, and the PR title claiming a suite root and image self-check that are not in the diff.
